description: Formal ten-seed recurrent-gate Figure 7 seed-level inference and pooled Supplementary 3 sign-versus-magnitude figures.
notes: Two SJC GPUs process five seeds each from the registered seed01-seed10 checkpoints.
Existing 53 MB trajectories reconstruct recurrent gates; full trial-by-connection caches are not saved.

Figure 7 displays uncorrected exact seed-level sign-flip p-values: the raw gap p-value for each group plus separate bar-versus-zero stars for the positive and negative bars; no multiple-testing correction is used.
The afferent companion transposes recurrent weight and gate source/destination axes before grouping, leaving TT/RR invariant and exchanging TR/RT; it has distinct _afferent outputs.
Supplementary 3 pools the ten compact seed outputs descriptively, matching the Supplementary 2 plotting protocol.
